newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - RUSSIA C.BANK SELLS 156 BLN RBLS BILLS, BONDS.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - RUSSIA C.BANK SELLS 156 BLN RBLS BILLS, BONDS.

text.p: The central bank sold 156.29 billion roubles ($26.9 million) nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds for the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21079 issue closed on Thursday at 84.93 percent, the 21083 issue closed at 84.28 percent and the 24017 issue closed at 96.55 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities partly to manage the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
